name: Confidentiality Term Cap
description: The confidentiality obligation must not exceed 3 years from disclosure, and must not be perpetual or indefinite.

name: Approved Governing Law
description: Governing law must be one of the firm's approved jurisdictions: Delaware, New York, or Texas.

name: Non-Solicitation Period Cap
description: If a non-solicitation clause is present, its restriction period must not exceed 12 months. Non-solicitation clauses are optional and are not required.

name: Standard Confidentiality Exclusions
description: The definition of Confidential Information must carve out information that is or becomes publicly available, was already known, is independently developed, or is rightfully received from a third party.

name: No Unlimited Liability
description: The contract must not impose unlimited liability or require indemnification against 'any and all' claims without a limiting cap.
